subject: Expansion of Hyperion teams: activation matrix, credits & rollout checklist
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Caldwell <sophie@hyperionhealth.com>, Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@hyperionhealth.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-30T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Expansion to 3 additional teams — quick kickoff questions

Hi Sophie / Tom,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, Hyperion is planning to add three new internal app teams onto the current tenant (patient-portal, claims-ingest, analytics-pipeline). To keep things tidy on our side I wanted to confirm a few items so we can put together an activation plan and a short SOW.

High-level asks:
- Target activation window: are you aiming for all teams live in the same week, or a staggered ramp?
- Expected steady-state QPS / token throughput per app (rough ballpark is fine) — helps with capacity planning and burst sizing.
- Any procurement constraints (PO lead times / legal review) we should factor into the timeline?

If you’re okay with it I’ll assemble an activation matrix (per-team keys, go-live checkpoints, rollback plan) and a one-page commercial summary (credits / term options) for procurement.

Next steps from my side: draft activation matrix + example order form and share for review by Tuesday.

Thanks,
Ben

--
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | (415) 555-0148

[Attachment: none in this message]

From: Sophie Caldwell <sophie@hyperionhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@hyperionhealth.com>
Cc: procurement@hyperionhealth.com
Date: 2026-10-30T11:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion to 3 additional teams — quick kickoff questions

Hi Ben — thanks for following up. Quick answers below:

- Staggered rollouts preferred: patient-portal in mid-Nov, claims-ingest late-Nov, analytics-pipeline in Jan. We want patient-facing first.
- Ballpark throughput: patient-portal ~200 qps peak, claims-ingest ~50 qps, analytics-pipeline low-latency batch calls ~10 qps but larger payloads.
- Procurement: procurement@hyperionhealth.com will need an order form + standard W-9. Legal review typically 7–10 business days.

Two asks from our side before we sign anything:
1) Can you offer a one-time renewal credit tied to the expansion? We’re budgeting for year-2 and a small credit would help finalize internal approvals.
2) We’d like a simple staggered activation (enable keys per-team) so we can validate telemetry and rollback per-team if needed.

If you send over the activation matrix and proposed credit options we’ll route to procurement and legal.

Thanks,
Sophie

--
Sophie Caldwell
Head of Product Operations | Hyperion Health
Sophie.Caldwell@hyperionhealth.com

Date: 2026-10-30T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Hyperion expansion — need pricing/credit recommendation

Team — forwarding Sophie's note and the rough cadence. Procurement will want an order form and a credit ask is on the table. My thinking: to keep procurement moving we can propose two options:

Option A — One-time expansion credit: 10% off the first 3 months of incremental usage (applied as an invoice credit). 12-month term on the expanded commit.
Option B — Larger one-time credit: $30k credit applied up front in exchange for a 12-month committed increase (tiered pricing thereafter).

Operational asks: Monica — can your team sketch a minimal activation runbook for staggered enablement (key issuance -> smoke tests -> pilot traffic -> full traffic) and an estimate of any onboarding time we should include?
Laura — any commercial concerns with the two options above? Markus — procurement/legal: would either option cause issues for Hyperion's PO/order process?

Attaching a first-pass activation matrix and a short SOW draft for your review.

Thanks,
Ben

[Attachment: hyperion_expansion_sow_v1.pdf (PDF, 78KB)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: ben.carter@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com, markus.klein@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-31T09:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Hyperion expansion — need pricing/credit recommendation

Nice framing, Ben. A couple of thoughts:

- I prefer Option B ($30k one-time credit) but structure it as a refundable credit that applies to the first invoice(s) for the expanded teams. That simplifies accounting for both sides.
- Request term: tie the credit to a 12-month commit for the expanded capacity with a mid-term review at 6 months (usage vs. commit).
- We should give them a simple rollback SLA in the runbook (e.g., keys disabled within 2 hours of a critical issue). Monica, can you add that to the runbook?

Ben — once Monica uploads the activation matrix with checkpoints I’ll approve and we can hand to legal for an order form. Markus — if you can draft the one-page order form (DocuSign-ready) based on $30k credit + 12-month commit we can share with Sophie.

Thanks,
Laura

Subject: Hyperion expansion — activation matrix + order form (draft)

Hi Sophie / Tom,

Appreciate the quick turnaround on answers. Attached is the proposed activation matrix (per-team keys, staging checkpoints, rollback window) and a short SOW + order-form draft reflecting the $30k one-time credit tied to a 12-month expanded commit. Highlights:

- Patient-portal: target go-live Nov 16 — limited pilot Nov 9–13. Key: patient-portal-api-key-01
- Claims-ingest: target go-live Nov 30 — pilot Nov 23–27. Key: claims-ingest-api-key-01
- Analytics-pipeline: target go-live Jan 11 — pilot Jan 4–8. Key: analytics-pipeline-api-key-01
- Rollback SLA: keys can be revoked within 2 hours; telemetry hold points at pilot + 24h + 7d.
- Commercial: $30,000 one-time credit applied to first invoice(s); 12-month commit for expanded capacity starting on the first expanded-team go-live.

Links: HubSpot deal (for your records) and DocuSign order-form are included below. If procurement needs any alternate wording on the PO or W-9, loop in procurement@redwood.com and I’ll have Markus handle it.

Requested next steps:
1) Sophie/procurement: confirm they can route this to legal and if Nov 9 pilot works for patient-portal.
2) Hyperion: sign DocuSign order-form (link below) or advise changes.
3) Monica/CS: start preflight checklist week of Nov 2 and set up the pilot telemetry dashboard.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-min call if you want to walk through the matrix together.

Best,
Ben
